server.config:
set sv_pure 1
set sv_autoRecordDemos 0
set sv_hostname "fntech3-reference-probe"
set sv_maxclients 2
set sv_fps 20
set cl_motd 0
set cl_allowDownload 0
set com_maxfps 60
set com_maxfpsUnfocused 60
set com_maxfpsMinimized 60
set name "fntech3_reference_probe"
set cl_shownet 2
version
set sv_master1 ""
set sv_master2 ""
set sv_master3 ""
set sv_master4 ""
set sv_master5 ""
map q3dm6
wait 700
quit
